name: Rudaki Avenue
tagline: The central boulevard the whole city hangs off
description: The tree-lined avenue running north to south through the middle of Dushanbe, with the government buildings, the National Museum, the fountains and most of the restaurants and hotels along its length. Walking it end to end is the city in an afternoon.
bestFor: Short stays wanting everything on one street
pros: Everything central is on or just off this avenue
Genuinely pleasant to walk under the trees
The National Museum and the flagpole park
cons: The most expensive part of the city
Photography near government buildings is restricted

name: Ismoili Somoni District
description: The area west and northwest of the centre, where much of Dushanbe's newer apartment construction has gone up, along with shopping centres and the better-serviced residential blocks. It is where most of the city's professional population lives.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting a newer flat with reliable services
pros: Newest apartment stock in the city
cons: A taxi ride from the centre

name: Shohmansur and the Green Bazaar
tagline: The market district and the older streets
description: The central district around the Mehrgon and Shohmansur bazaars, where the fruit that Tajikistan is famous for is sold, along with the older low-rise streets and the mahalla neighbourhoods behind them. It is the most local part of the city.
bestFor: Budget stays and anyone who wants the markets on the doorstep
pros: The bazaars and the best fruit in Central Asia
Cheapest food and rent in the centre

name: Varzob Gorge
tagline: The mountain road north, where the city escapes
description: The valley running north from Dushanbe into the Hissar range, with the river, summer houses and the road that eventually leads towards the Fann Mountains. It is where Dushanbe goes at the weekend and where the air is cleanest.
bestFor: Anyone who wants the mountains within reach of the capital
pros: Cool mountain air and the river
The route north towards the Fann Mountains
Considerably cleaner air than the city
cons: Thirty minutes or more from the centre
The road can be difficult in winter
